command.showChromeSettings.title: ZCode: Open display settings
command.setQuotaApiKey.title: ZCode: Set quota API key
config.quotaAdapters.description: Optional read-only quota adapters for custom providers. Match providerId exactly. Use JSON Pointer paths such as /data/balance; secrets are stored with the Set quota API key command, never in settings. HTTPS is required except unauthenticated localhost HTTP.
quotaAdapter.schemaVersion.description: Optional adapter schema version. Omission means version 1; future versions will keep existing version 1 settings compatible.
quotaAdapter.id.description: Stable unique id used to store this adapter's secret.
quotaAdapter.providerId.description: Exact providerId shown by the active model, for example deepseek or your custom provider id.
quotaAdapter.providerTemplateId.descript: Optional exact ZCode shortcut templateId required before reusing its stored API key.
quotaAdapter.providerBaseURL.description: Optional trusted provider base URL used to verify the key destination when ZCode has no base URL configured.
quotaAdapter.displayName.description: Friendly name shown when saving an API key.
quotaAdapter.endpoint.description: HTTPS quota endpoint. Credentials in URL query parameters are rejected.
quotaAdapter.requests.description: Optional set of up to five read-only requests. All requests must use the same HTTPS origin so the saved key cannot be sent to another host.
quotaAdapter.request.id.description: Unique response name used as the first JSON Pointer segment when mapping combined results.
quotaAdapter.method.description: Read-only request method. POST sends a fixed JSON body.
quotaAdapter.auth.description: Authentication method used when sending the API key.
quotaAdapter.apiKeySource.description: Read the key from VS Code SecretStorage, or reuse the key ZCode stores for the exact providerId. Requests must match the configured provider host or providerBaseURL.
quotaAdapter.authHeaderName.description: Header name used when auth is header, for example x-api-key.
quotaAdapter.authHeaderPrefix.descriptio: Only for header auth. Optional prefix added before the stored key, for example 'Token ' for Authorization.
quotaAdapter.requestHeaders.description: Static non-secret headers required by the API.
quotaAdapter.body.description: Fixed JSON object for POST. No secret or template interpolation is supported.
quotaAdapter.itemsPath.description: JSON Pointer to an array of quota rows, for example /data/limits. Leave empty to map the response root.
quotaAdapter.percentScale.description: Whether percentage values are fractions from 0 to 1 or percentages from 0 to 100.
quotaAdapter.allowedCurrencies.descripti: Optional allowlist of ISO 4217 currency codes for monetary balances.
quotaAdapter.fields.description: Each mapping produces a quota row from each item at itemsPath.
quotaAdapter.field.label.description: Fixed row label. Used when labelPath is not set.
quotaAdapter.field.labelPath.description: JSON Pointer to the row label.
JSON Pointer to remaining percentage. Takes precedence over usedPercentPath.
quotaAdapter.field.usedPercentPath.descr: JSON Pointer to used percentage; remaining percentage is calculated as 100 minus this value.
quotaAdapter.field.remainingCountPath.de: JSON Pointer to remaining units or requests.
quotaAdapter.field.nextResetTimePath.des: JSON Pointer to reset time as ISO text or a Unix timestamp.
quotaAdapter.field.resetTimeFormat.descr: How to parse the reset time. Auto treats numeric values below 1e12 as seconds.
quotaAdapter.field.remainingAmountPath.d: JSON Pointer to a remaining monetary balance; set currency or currencyPath too.
quotaAdapter.field.currency.description: Static ISO 4217 currency code such as USD or CNY.
quotaAdapter.field.currencyPath.descript: JSON Pointer to the ISO 4217 currency code.
quotaAdapter.field.grantedAmountPath.des: Optional JSON Pointer to a granted or promotional balance.
quotaAdapter.field.toppedUpAmountPath.de: Optional JSON Pointer to a topped-up balance.
quotaAdapter.field.amountDivisor.descrip: Optional positive divisor applied to mapped monetary amounts, such as cents to currency units.
quotaAdapter.field.countDivisor.descript: Optional positive divisor applied to the remaining count, such as milli-tokens to tokens.
quotaAdapter.field.quotaCalculation.desc: Derive a remaining count and percentage from total and used values.
quotaAdapter.field.quotaLimitPath.descri: JSON Pointer to a total count or quota. For multiple requests, start with the request ID.
quotaAdapter.field.quotaUsedPath.descrip: JSON Pointer to the used count or quota. For multiple requests, start with the request ID.
quotaAdapter.field.quotaLimitDivisor.des: Optional positive divisor applied to the total value before calculating the remaining count.
quotaAdapter.field.quotaUsedDivisor.desc: Optional positive divisor applied to the used value before calculating the remaining count.
quotaAdapter.field.metrics.description: Optional custom numeric readings shown in the quota panel; they do not imply a quota percentage.
quotaAdapter.metric.valuePath.descriptio: JSON Pointer to a finite number or numeric string.
quotaAdapter.metric.valueDivisor.descrip: Optional positive divisor for a directly mapped value, for example 100 to convert cents to currency units.
quotaAdapter.metric.calculation.descript: Combine numeric response fields with a restricted arithmetic operation instead of writing code.
quotaAdapter.metric.calculationOperation: Operation: sum, subtract, multiply, divide, min, or max. Subtract and divide require exactly two paths.
quotaAdapter.metric.calculationPaths.des: JSON Pointer paths for numeric fields. For multiple requests, prefix each path with its request ID, such as /usage/cost.
quotaAdapter.metric.calculationDivisor.d: Optional positive scale applied after the operation, for example 100 to convert cents to currency units.
quotaAdapter.metric.format.description: Show as a localized number or currency amount.
quotaAdapter.metric.currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code required for currency format, such as CNY or USD.
quotaAdapter.metric.currencyPath.descrip: JSON Pointer to the ISO 4217 currency code when it varies in the response.
quotaAdapter.metric.unit.description: Optional unit for number format, such as tokens or requests.
quotaAdapter.metric.period.description: Optional time period included with the reading name, such as Today or This month.
quotaAdapter.metric.periodPath.descripti: JSON Pointer to a response field containing the time period when it varies by row.
quotaAdapter.field.budgetCalculation.des: Calculate remaining money and percentage from separate total and used values.
quotaAdapter.field.budgetLimitPath.descr: JSON Pointer to the total budget. For multiple requests, start with the request id, for example /plan/limit.
quotaAdapter.field.budgetLimitDivisor.de: Optional positive divisor for the limit amount, for example 100 to convert cents to currency units.
quotaAdapter.field.budgetUsedPath.descri: JSON Pointer to the used amount. For multiple requests, start with the request id, for example /usage/total.
quotaAdapter.field.budgetUsedDivisor.des: Divide the used amount by this value before subtraction, for example 100 when the API reports cents and the limit is in dollars.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: ZCode Chat starts a local ZCode process, so it only runs in trusted workspaces.
config.formulaFonts.description: Download KaTeX fonts when a formula appears. auto asks beside the reply, on downloads and keeps the fonts, and off uses system fonts without asking.
